visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white button-down shirt and black trousers, walks forward in a spacious outdoor pedestrian plaza. In the far background, a very tall light-blue skyscraper rises into the sky, framed by red commercial building structures and palm trees. The lighting is bright and natural daylight. (2) The woman approaches a large rectangular pillar that serves as an advertising display. She uses her hands to point at large posters on the pillar featuring a female face and a male face. Brightly colored graphic text overlays begin to appear around her as she gestures towards the celebrity images. (3) The woman leans towards the side of the pillar featuring the male portrait, performing a hugging motion with her arms. She smiles directly at the camera while standing in front of the large vertical text. The camera remains at eye-level, capturing her upper body and the surrounding urban environment.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Location Setup -> Brand Reveal -> Humorous Punchline
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional vlog designed to showcase the brand 'Better Biosciences' and its celebrity endorsements. By filming at a high-traffic location in Taipei featuring their billboard, the creator uses a humorous linguistic pun involving the celebrity 'Yesung' and the product 'probiotics' to create a memorable and engaging advertisement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly names the brand 'Better Biosciences' (好好生醫), showcases their physical advertising pillar, and discusses their spokespeople.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively leverages the iconic Taipei 101 as a backdrop to establish a sense of scale and prestige for the brand. The use of the 'Yesung/Probiotic' pun is the central creative hook.
